exposure: Neonates born to mothers with SARS-CoV-2 infection
Delivery indicated by worsening maternal COVID-19 symptoms
outcome: Positive SARS-CoV-2 test results in neonates
Clinical signs of COVID-19 in neonates
cohort: 255 neonates born to mothers with positive SARS-CoV-2 test results
finding: High maternal social vulnerability was associated with a higher likelihood of neonatal test result positivity, adjusted for maternal COVID-19 symptoms, delivery mode, and rooming-in practice
mod_finding: This study examined the relationship between maternal COVID-19 status and neonatal outcomes, controlling for mode of delivery.
